marrow__ANAT_CH10_Q019.takeaway: The clitoris develops from the genital tubercle; the urogenital groove contributes to the vestibule.
marrow__ANAT_CH10_Q019.displayText:
Agenesis of the clitoris occurs due to a defect in the development of the genital tubercle.

The vestibule is derived from the urogenital groove.

rationales.a: Urethral folds contribute to the boundaries of the urethral and vestibular region, but the clitoris develops from the genital tubercle.
rationales.b: The urogenital groove contributes to the vestibule; it does not form the clitoris.
rationales.d: Genital swellings contribute to external genital structures such as the labia majora, whereas the clitoris develops from the genital tubercle.
